about: I am a development enthusiast focused on programming, computer technology, and AI. I often build with Python and JavaScript, explore interesting stacks and tools, and turn ideas into working projects.
These projects usually start from a small idea and are refined step by step into complete features.

This site records my projects, experiments, and technical notes, and also shares thoughts and lessons from development. The content is practice-oriented and focuses on implementation and optimization.
If you are interested in development, technical exploration, or creative coding, I hope you find something useful here.
If you need help, feel free to email me.

about.title: About me and this blog
about.subtitle: A place for projects, experiments, tutorials, and notes about games, system tools, and AI.
paragraphs: Hello, welcome to my blog. This site is both my personal homepage and a place to organize technical notes and project updates. I may also post things that seem unrelated to technology… don't be mistaken, I might simply be recording a bit of my life :)

I mainly research cybersecurity and the applications of large AI models across different areas. I also write about iOS sideloading, Windows tips, virtual machines, Steam beginner guides, and other related topics. Most of these are based on my own experiences and the pitfalls I've encountered.

The tutorials try to keep practical notes, risk reminders, and lessons learned. If a post mentions images that are not shown here, you can usually find them on the original platform or contact me by email. (I'm really sorry, but I don't have that much time, so I may not be able to move all the images here.)
I hope this site helps people who enjoy tinkering with devices, exploring software, and building creative projects. Suggestions and corrections are always welcome.
